output.objection: You are treating my manual training pipeline as a defect to be fixed without asking, but I am happy to keep it manual if you automate the registry and evaluation hand over. Do not pretend you are taking something from me that I never offered to give up.
output.correction: I did not say the training pipeline is broken, I said it is a trade off I am willing to make. You filed this as a technical failure when it is actually a negotiation about where we spend our automation budget.
